messages:
paul-finance: FYI AtlasLogistics (acct AL-212) added ACH but both micro-deposits were returned with bank msg: "account_name_mismatch". They registered the subsidiary 'Atlas Logistics West' but bank expects parent name 'Atlas Holdings LLC'.
jen-support: Opening a support ticket and asked customer to confirm which entity owns the bank account. They replied that the bank account is on the parent company but they submitted subsidiary details to match their invoice.
omar-payments: I pulled the instrument: vault id ach-al212-3, name_on_account='Atlas Logistics West', routing=041000124, acct=*******4321. Bank returned NACHA R01 + custom name mismatch. Micro-deposits attempted: +0.09, +0.03.
payments-bot: Automated retries scheduled (job: retry-1856002468-01) but set to hold pending finance/legal decision due to mismatched legal entity.
paul-finance: We should not auto-retry if the account owner differs from invoiced entity — risk of failed reconciliation and tax/AR issues. Recommend payment_hold_manual and request either: (1) parent authorization to allow payment for subsidiary invoices, or (2) re-submit ACH under parent name with supporting docs.
lisa-sales: Customer called — they want to pay via ACH and avoid wire fees. They're OK to provide a signed intercompany authorization but want quick guidance on docs.
nance-legal: For inter-entity payment we need (A) a signed letter on parent letterhead authorizing payment for named invoice(s) or (B) a vendor bank confirmation letter. Also confirm whether payment should be booked to the subsidiary or cleared as intercompany and credited centrally. I'll draft a short template authorization.
toni-accounting: Operationally, if parent pays, we can apply payment to the subsidiary invoice but must create an intercompany receivable entry for consolidation. Need to know if they'd like us to net to parent GL. Also watch for tax implications. Creating FIN-3922 to track.
omar-payments: Payments-bot has put retry job on hold per request. If customer re-issues ACH under parent name we can trigger a fresh micro-deposit cycle in ~24-48h. If they prefer wire, we can accept immediate funds; will need payer details to match.
payments-bot: Retry job put on hold by omar-payments at 1856002501. Wire fallback available.
paul-finance: Please set invoice INV-2026-845 to payment_hold_manual and suspend dunning for 7 days while we collect docs. Also avoid adding late fees until resolved.
jen-support: (typo) — jen fixed: invoice set to hold.
jen-support: Draft to customer: "Thanks — to accept your payment from Atlas Holdings LLC we need a signed authorization on Atlas Holdings letterhead or a bank letter confirming account ownership. If you prefer, we can accept a one-time wire today to clear INV-2026-845. Which do you prefer?"
lisa-sales: Sending that now. Customer replied they will upload a signed authorization and a bank confirmation PDF. They asked for a redacted wire template in case the docs take longer.
nance-legal: I'll circulate the short authorization template in the support thread. Note: require signatory name, title, date, and scope of invoices covered.
toni-accounting: Creating GL memo GL-INT-AL212 to record intercompany receivable path. Flagging for reconciliation once payment posts.
omar-payments: Once docs are received, I will either flip instrument name_on_account to 'Atlas Holdings LLC' (with audit trail) and restart micro-deposits, or accept the wire and mark invoice PAID on settlement. If they upload both, prefer ACH for lower fees.
payments-bot: If wire chosen, create watch job wire-watch-1856002468 to auto-match on 'INV-2026-845' or 'AL-212'.
lisa-sales: Customer uploaded authorization and bank confirmation at 1856002602. They say their treasury wants ACH; please proceed with micro-deposits against parent name.
omar-payments: Received docs. Updating instrument name to 'Atlas Holdings LLC' with reference to uploaded authorization. Triggering new micro-deposit cycle now. Micro-deposits sent: +0.02, +0.07.
payments-bot: Micro-deposits in flight. Waiting for customer verification.
paul-finance: Good. Leave invoice on hold until verification completes and ACH settles. Toni — make sure GL memo notes original payer as parent and target entity as subsidiary for audit trail.
toni-accounting: Will do. FIN-3922 updated with GL-INT-AL212 and attachment pointers.
nance-legal: Saving signed authorization into contract docs and noting acceptance criteria for future intercompany payments. We'll add a short line to onboarding checklist: 'If paying via different legal entity, upload authorization'.
jen-support: Customer verified micro-deposits at 1856002668. ACH verification accepted, invoice payment queued for settlement (2-3 business days). Marking thread resolved.
payments-bot: Final status: ACH verified; settlement pending. Removing hold after verification.
paul-finance: Closing loop — invoice pending settlement. If any mismatch or short-pay shows up, re-open FIN-3922. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
